Mola blouse with yoke and sleeves of yellow synthetic textile.  [El.B 25/10/2011]

Mola. Blouse with yoke and sleeves of white-spotted red fabric.  Neck,  sleeves and bottom  edge bound;  applique band on shoulders.  The mola panels have 2 layers:  red and orange on blue.  Both sides have similar designs of large circles containing animals. Hand stitched.
Mola blouse with four-layer mola panels. [El.B 25/10/2011]

Mola. Blouse with yellow yoke and sleeves.  Neck bound, with drawstring.  Applied strips on shoulders.  Bottom edge has orange frill, for tucking into skirt.  Mola panels  have 2 layers:  red and blue on white.  The two sides have different designs: ?human figures on one, 'abstract' patterns on the other. Hand stitched.

Mola. Blouse with yoke and sleeves of purple velvet, sleeves edged with lace.  A sewing machine has been used for the upper part of the blouse as well as for the side seams and turning under the bottom edge.  The neck is bound,  with a drawstring.  Applied strips on shoulders.  The  mola panels have 3 layers: red on yellow/orange on red,  with pieces of other colours also applied.  The front and back panels have a similar 'mask' design (c.f. 1924.46.76).

Mola. Blouse with pink yoke and sleeves.  Neck, sleeves and bottom edge bound.  Applied strips on shoulders.  Mola panels have 3 layers: red on yellow on blue print.  Different prints  are  used for front and back.  On one side design of large ?bat or bird with outstretched wings, with an animal;  on the other, 2 large ovals, ?turtles.  Hand stitched.
Mola. Blouse with blue yoke and sleeves.

Mola. Blouse with orange yoke and sleeves.  Sleeves hemmed.  Neck has drawstring.  Applied strips on shoulders.  Lower edges turned  under and hemmed.  Mola panels have 2 layers:  red and yellow on blue print.  On  one side a design of a large bird with outstretched wings, surrounded by snake(s).  On the other, smaller, similar birds standing on animals' backs;  in the centre a ?bird or man, upside down.  Hand stitched.
Panel for a mola blouse.

Mola. Blouse with plain blue yoke and sleeves.  Neck bound, applique band on shoulders, lower edge bound.  Applique panels have 3 layers, red on white/yellow on red/white print, with patches of other fabrics giving polychrome effect.  Design is similar on both sides, a semicircular `mask' pattern. Hand stitched.
Blouse Mola. Zoomorphic design including a winged creature. Hand stitched.
Mola. Blouse with yoke and sleeves of heavy light blue fabric.

Mola. Blouse with yellow yoke and sleeves, drawstring at neck,  applique bands on shoulders.  The molas panels have 2 layers:  red and blue on a pink/white print.  Both sides have a design of four animals facing each other,  infilled with smaller animals and geometric patterns.  The blue layer of one top layer has been extended with a piece of lighter blue fabric. Hand stitched.
Mola. Blouse with plain black yoke and sleeves.

Mola. Blouse with pink yoke and sleeves.  Sleeves hemmed.  Drawstring at neck.  Applied strips on shoulders.  Bottom edge bound, with applique strips machine-stitched on.  Mola panels have 3 layers:  red on white on blue.  On one side a human figure flanked by 2 winged animals.  On the other a bird of prey, upside down, flanked by animals.

Mola. Blouse with yoke and sleeves of striped black fabric.  Sleeves and bottom edge bound, drawstring at neck, applied strips on shoulders.  Mola panels have 2 layers:  red and orange  on blue check.  On one  side a design of 4 animals, upside down;  on the other, 2 large animals, sideways.  The blouse is probably unfinished, as large areas of the blue check base are not covered by applique. Hand stitched.

Mola. Blouse with yoke and sleeves of black striped fabric.  Sleeves hemmed, neck bound, applied strips on  shoulders, lower edges turned under and stitched together.  Mola panels have 2 layers:  red and orange on black-and-white striped print.  Similar design  on both sides:  human/animal/bird figures. Hand stitched.

Mola. Blouse with dark pink yoke and sleeves.  Sleeves hemmed, neck bound, applied strips on shoulders, lower edges turned under and oversewn.  Mola panels have 5 layers:  yellow on blue on red on blue print on orange.  Front design mirrors back: a central bird surrounded by 3 ?monkeys.  Hand stitched.
